overview.description: The 21Shares Dogecoin ETF (TDOG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long doge, short usd currency. The fund provides exposure to the daily price movements, net of expenses, of the US dollar price of Dogecoin (DOGE) through an ETF structure. The Custodian holds most DOGE and their private keys in cold storage (offline). TDOG was launched on Jan 22, 2026 and is issued by 21Shares.
